def transform(grid):

    H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0])

    mr=sorted({r for r,_ in M}); mc=sorted({c for _,c in M})

def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    vals=Counter(v for r in grid for v in r)
    block=vals.most_common(1)[0][0]
    line=[v for v,c in vals.most_common() if v!=block][0]
    hrows=[r for r in range(H) if sum(grid[r][c]==line for c in range(W))>=W/2]
    vcols=[c for c in range(W) if sum(grid[r][c]==line for r in range(H))>=H/2]
    M={(r,c):grid[r][c] for r in hrows for c in vcols if grid[r][c]!=line}
    mr=sorted({r for r,_ in M}); mc=sorted({c for _,c in M})
    hrows=[r for r in hrows if mr[0]<=r<=mr[-1]]   # keep full lines only inside marked span
    vcols=[c for c in vcols if mc[0]<=c<=mc[-1]]
    nR,nC=len(hrows)-1,len(vcols)-1
    out=[[block]*nC for _ in range(nR)]
    for i in range(nR):
        for j in range(nC):
            corners=[(hrows[i],vcols[j]),(hrows[i],vcols[j+1]),(hrows[i+1],vcols[j]),(hrows[i+1],vcols[j+1])]
            cv=[M[k] for k in corners if k in M]
            if len(cv)==4 and len(set(cv))==1: out[i][j]=cv[0]
